# Feature Reference

33 features in frozen column order. `n` = series length, `m` = mean,
`s` = population std (ddof=0), `d = diff(x)`. NaN semantics follow
[Numerics and NaN policy](numerics.md): `min_length` is the shortest
defined length, `nan_when` lists the other undefined conditions.

| # | Feature | Definition | Min length | NaN when | numpy / tsfresh / TSFEL / catch22 |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `mean` | sum(x)/n | 1 | never | `np.mean(x)` / `mean` / `Mean` / — |
| 1 | `std` | sqrt(var), population (ddof=0) | 1 | never | `np.std(x, ddof=0)` / `standard_deviation` / `Standard deviation` / — |
| 2 | `var` | sum((x-m)^2)/n, forced to exactly 0.0 on constant series | 1 | never | `np.var(x, ddof=0)` / `variance` / `Variance` / — |
| 3 | `min` | smallest value | 1 | never | `np.min(x)` / `minimum` / `Min` / — |
| 4 | `max` | largest value | 1 | never | `np.max(x)` / `maximum` / `Max` / — |
| 5 | `median` | 50th percentile, linear interpolation (numpy default) | 1 | never | `np.median(x)` / `median` / `Median` / — |
| 6 | `quantile_10` | 10th percentile, linear interpolation | 1 | never | `np.percentile(x, 10)` / `quantile__q_0.1` / — / — |
| 7 | `quantile_25` | 25th percentile, linear interpolation | 1 | never | `np.percentile(x, 25)` / `quantile__q_0.25` / — / — |
| 8 | `quantile_75` | 75th percentile, linear interpolation | 1 | never | `np.percentile(x, 75)` / `quantile__q_0.75` / — / — |
| 9 | `quantile_90` | 90th percentile, linear interpolation | 1 | never | `np.percentile(x, 90)` / `quantile__q_0.9` / — / — |
| 10 | `skewness` | (m3/n)/(var*std), m3 = sum((x-m)^3); scipy bias=True | 2 | std == 0 | `scipy.stats.skew(x, bias=True)` / `skewness` / `Skewness` / — |
| 11 | `kurtosis` | (m4/n)/var^2 - 3 (Fisher excess); scipy bias=True | 2 | std == 0 | `scipy.stats.kurtosis(x, fisher=True, bias=True)` / `kurtosis` / `Kurtosis` / — |
| 12 | `abs_energy` | sum(x^2) | 1 | never | `np.sum(x**2)` / `abs_energy` / `Absolute energy` / — |
| 13 | `root_mean_square` | sqrt(sum(x^2)/n) | 1 | never | `np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2))` / `root_mean_square` / `Root mean square` / — |
| 14 | `mean_abs_change` | sum|x[i+1]-x[i]|/(n-1) | 2 | n < 2 | `np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(x)))` / `mean_abs_change` / `Mean absolute diff` / — |
| 15 | `mean_change` | (x[n-1]-x[0])/(n-1) | 2 | n < 2 | `np.mean(np.diff(x))` / `mean_change` / `Mean diff` / — |
| 16 | `cid_ce` | sqrt(sum(((x[i+1]-x[i])/std)^2)); exactly 0.0 when std == 0 | 2 | n < 2 | `np.sqrt(np.sum(np.diff(x)**2))` / `cid_ce__normalize_False` / — / — |
| 17 | `mean_second_derivative_central` | sum(x[i+1]-2*x[i]+x[i-1])/(2*(n-2)) | 3 | n < 3 | `np.mean((x[2:] - 2*x[1:-1] + x[:-2]) / 2.0)` / `mean_second_derivative_central` / — / — |
| 18 | `zero_crossings` | count of i with (x[i] > 0) != (x[i+1] > 0) | 1 | never | `np.sum(np.diff(x > 0).astype(bool))` / — / `Zero crossing rate` / — |
| 19 | `mean_crossings` | count of i with (x[i] > m) != (x[i+1] > m) | 1 | never | `np.sum(np.diff(x > np.mean(x)).astype(bool))` / — / — / — |
| 20 | `number_of_peaks` | count of i strictly greater than all 3 neighbors on each side | 1 | never (0 when n <= 6) | `scipy.signal.find_peaks(x)[0].size` / `number_peaks__n_1` / `Peak to peak distance` / — |
| 21 | `longest_strike_above_mean` | longest run with x[i] > m | 1 | never | `max_streak(x > np.mean(x))` / `longest_strike_above_mean` / — / — |
| 22 | `longest_strike_below_mean` | longest run with x[i] < m | 1 | never | `max_streak(x < np.mean(x))` / `longest_strike_below_mean` / — / — |
| 23 | `autocorr_lag_1` | sum((x[i]-m)(x[i+1]-m))/((n-1)*var) | 2 | n <= 1 or var == 0 | `np.corrcoef(x[:-1], x[1:])[0,1]` / `autocorrelation__lag_1` / `Autocorrelation` / `CO_Embed2_Dist_tau_d_expfit_meandiff` |
| 24 | `autocorr_lag_2` | sum((x[i]-m)(x[i+2]-m))/((n-2)*var) | 3 | n <= 2 or var == 0 | `np.corrcoef(x[:-2], x[2:])[0,1]` / `autocorrelation__lag_2` / — / — |
| 25 | `autocorr_lag_5` | sum((x[i]-m)(x[i+5]-m))/((n-5)*var) | 6 | n <= 5 or var == 0 | `np.corrcoef(x[:-5], x[5:])[0,1]` / `autocorrelation__lag_5` / — / — |
| 26 | `autocorr_lag_10` | sum((x[i]-m)(x[i+10]-m))/((n-10)*var) | 11 | n <= 10 or var == 0 | `np.corrcoef(x[:-10], x[10:])[0,1]` / `autocorrelation__lag_10` / — / — |
| 27 | `trend_slope` | least-squares slope vs t = 0..n-1; exactly 0.0 on constant series | 2 | n < 2 | `scipy.stats.linregress(range(N), x).slope` / `linear_trend__attr_slope` / `Linear trend` / — |
| 28 | `trend_r2` | squared Pearson r of (t, x) | 2 | n < 2 or var == 0 | `scipy.stats.linregress(range(N), x).rvalue**2` / `linear_trend__attr_rvalue` / — / — |
| 29 | `permutation_entropy` | normalized order-3 delay-1 ordinal-pattern entropy (/ln 6) | 3 | n < 3 | `antropy.perm_entropy(x, order=3, delay=1, normalize=True)` / `permutation_entropy__dimension_3__tau_1` / — / — |
| 30 | `dominant_frequency` | argmax power-bin frequency (k+1)/n over FFT bins 1..=n/2, DC excluded | 2 | n < 2, constant series, or non-finite/zero total power | `np.argmax(np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x))[1:]) + 1` / — / `Max power spectrum` / `SP_Summaries_welch_rect_centroid` |
| 31 | `spectral_centroid` | sum(f*p)/sum(p) over FFT bins 1..=n/2 | 2 | n < 2, constant series, or non-finite/zero total power | `np.sum(freqs * mag) / np.sum(mag)` / — / `Spectral centroid` / `SP_Summaries_welch_rect_centroid` |
| 32 | `spectral_entropy` | shannon(p/sum(p))/ln(nbins); 0.0 when nbins == 1 | 2 | n < 2, constant series, or non-finite/zero total power | `antropy.spectral_entropy(x, sf=1.0, method='fft', normalize=True)` / — / `Spectral entropy` / — |

Cost classes: `A` fused reductions, `B` order statistics, `C` spectral/FFT,
`D` autocorrelations. Intermediates (`needs`) show shared computation.
